findings.text: When the captured stack has fewer than three lines, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` becomes ''. `String(err.stack).endsWith('')` is always true, so the request stack is never appended. The original regex did not match in that case and compared against the whole stack, so it did append. Failing input: a short `dummy.stack` such as 'at a\nat b' (no trailing newline) and an `err.stack` that already exists. The async stack is silently dropped, which is a fail-open duplicate check.
